profile.name: USB通信端点
profile.description: 用于与各类通过 USB 连接的实验仪器进行底层数据交换的通用通信端点。它通常存在于 USB 设备内部，用于主机与仪器之间传输命令、测量数据或状态信息，常见于数据采集设备、控制器和其他实验室电子仪器。
profile.description_en: A generic low-level communication endpoint used to exchange data with laboratory instruments connected over USB. It typically exists within a USB device and is used to transfer commands, measurement data, or status information between the host and the instrument, commonly in data acquisition devices, controllers, and other electronic lab equipment.
